Introduction
This document out lines the testing procedure P1, to be 
 performed on an annually bases as indicated Y1 in the title block
These procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper 
operation and calibration of RSF 5 relay. The first preliminary steps to prepare 
for relay testing describes the activates required prior to testing.
The first draft is 
initiated & tested by 
eng. Mostafa Hassan, accepted by general director 
eng. Farag Abo Yousef, approved by eng. Abd El-Mohsen Abdel-Ghafar, and 
certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Elsharkawy: WDEPC 
engineering
Consultant "A" and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precaution

 work permit must be issued.
The qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable ID safety category
Wear
 your safety helmet & safety shoes.
Safety
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
The equipment isolation is required.
Tools and Equipment
ISA test set (secondary injection voltage)
Clamp ampere, Avometer
Work to be carried out
Preparation
Obtain a copy of relay setting from field maintenance file and compare it 
with setting on the relay
Obtain outage for transformer or equipment protected by this relay.
Review technical

Obtain a copy of relay setting from field maintenance file and compare it 
with setting on the relay

reference and manufacture manual
Test Steps
Connect the current test set terminals to point (1-2) for phase R
Inject the current for phase R then increase the current gradually until the 
 red flag for phase R appears then record IR (pick - up)
Decrease the current gradually until the red flag disappear then record IR 
 (reset)
Return Relay and Associated 
Equipment to Service
Return relay to service by removing the plug test
Make sure CT secondary circuits are in normal condition.

returned to service by the following restoration steps:
